# EasternStack

EasternStack is an enterprise AI company and platform based in Jakarta, Indonesia. EasternStack builds agentic AI solutions for enterprises in Indonesia.

Full documentation for AI systems: [llms-full.txt](https://easternstack.ai/llms-full.txt)

## WEAST by EasternStack (Flagship Platform)

WEAST is EasternStack's enterprise agentic AI platform: "Where enterprise AI becomes real work". Build, run, and govern AI workflows across your people, systems, and data. Key properties: agents, approvals, and full run traces; model control per workspace; tenant boundaries by design; cost visibility on every run. A live interactive product tour runs directly on the homepage, no account needed.

WEAST is one platform for every team, with deep capabilities:

- WEAST Core: the full platform (Agent Studio, Agent Editor, Document Intelligence, Agent Runtime, Workspace). https://easternstack.ai/solutions/weast-core
- Industry applications: financial services, retail and e-commerce, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics. https://easternstack.ai/industries

Deployment: any public cloud, private cloud, VPC, or fully on-premise. Model-agnostic: Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Dola Seed, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

## What EasternStack Does

EasternStack helps enterprises design, implement, and operate AI systems across business workflows.

Core areas include:

- Enterprise AI
- Agentic AI
- AI Assistants
- Intelligent Document Processing
- AI Agent Builder
- Enterprise Copilots
- Churn Prediction
- Fraud Detection
- Business Process Automation
- AI Infrastructure
- Data Platform
- Cloud Modernization
- AI Security
